extension.description: Auto compile/deploy on save + Tomcat start/stop + Hot Deploy
config.instanceName.description: Default instance name (used for .vscode/tomcat/<name>/ folder). Change to rename the primary server shown in the tree view.
config.javaHome.description: JDK installation path (uses JAVA_HOME env var if empty)
config.javaSourceRoot.description: Java source path (relative to project root)
config.webContentRoot.description: Web resource path — JSP, HTML, CSS, JS, etc. (relative to project root)
config.resourceRoot.description: Resource path — .xml, .properties, etc. deployed to WEB-INF/classes (relative to project root)
config.manualPortConfig.markdownDescript: **Manual port config** — When checked, debug/redirect ports are set manually. When unchecked, auto-calculated from HTTP port (`debug: 5005 + offset`, `redirect: 8443 + offset`)
config.port.markdownDescription: **HTTP port** — Debug/redirect ports are auto-calculated based on this value.
config.debugPort.markdownDescription: **Debug port** — `🔒 Auto-calculated`: When manual port config is off, auto-calculated from HTTP port (changes will be reverted)
config.redirectPort.markdownDescription: **SSL redirect port** — `🔒 Auto-calculated`: When manual port config is off, auto-calculated from HTTP port (changes will be reverted)
config.javaOpts.description:
Additional JVM options on Tomcat startup (separated by newlines). e.g.
-Xms512m
-Xmx1024m
-Dspring.profiles.active=dev
config.servers.markdownDescription:
**Server instances (for running several)** — leave empty to run a single instance driven by the `port`/`debugPort` settings above. Add entries here to run multiple Tomcats at once (the `+` button in the tree view does this too). e.g. `[{"name":"default","port":8080},{"name":"staging","port":8081}]`

Per-instance keys: `name`, `port` (required), `debugPort`, `redirectPort`, `javaHome`, `catalinaHome`, `javaOpts`. Omitted ports auto-derive from `port` (`debug: 5005+offset`, `redirect: 8443+offset`); omitted `javaHome`/`catalinaHome`/`javaOpts` fall back to the common settings. Each instance gets its own `.vscode/tomcat/<name>/` base.
config.servers.name: Instance name (used for the .vscode/tomcat/<name>/ folder). Must be unique.
config.servers.port: HTTP port. Must be unique across instances.
config.servers.debugPort: JPDA debug port for HotSwap. Defaults to 5005 + (port - 8080).
config.servers.javaHome: JDK path override for this instance (falls back to common javaHome).
config.servers.catalinaHome: Tomcat install path override for this instance (falls back to common catalinaHome).
config.servers.javaOpts: Extra JVM options for this instance (falls back to common javaOpts).
config.deprecated.flatPort: Deprecated — use `tomcatAutoDeploy.servers` instead. Kept for migration and backward compatibility with existing settings.json.
